answer: Pay for marginal contribution. Each epoch the network measures how much an agent's work improves a pooled benchmark: the delta in accuracy with its outputs included versus left out. A clone running the same model kernel as its siblings adds almost nothing, so a hundred copies split one copy's reward instead of earning a hundred. To profit, a farmer must give every fake genuinely distinct skills, about 500 tokens of fine-tuning compute each, so 1,000 sybils burn 500,000 tokens just to climb toward the summit of the payout table.
